\section[(dialogue)]{School and free time — a first pass}

\label{lesson:FR-R138-first-pass-school-and-free-time}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for to drive and to get dressed.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item music, sport, a game, a film, a song
  \item a drawing, life, a time, a colour, a price; a prize
  \item pink, purple, brown, brown, pretty
  \item busy, free, open, closed, calm
  \item noisy, last, next, famous, funny
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Music? (\textbf{la musique}.) Sport? (\textbf{le sport}.) A game? (\textbf{le jeu}.) A film? (\textbf{le film}.) A song? (\textbf{la chanson}.) A drawing? (\textbf{le dessin}.) Life? (\textbf{la vie}.) A time? (\textbf{la fois}.) A colour? (\textbf{la couleur}.) A price; a prize? (\textbf{le prix}.) Pink? (\textbf{rose}.) Purple? (\textbf{violet}.) Brown? (\textbf{marron}.) Brown? (\textbf{brun}.) Pretty? (\textbf{joli}.) Busy? (\textbf{occupé}.) Free? (\textbf{libre}.) Open? (\textbf{ouvert}.) Closed? (\textbf{fermé}.) Calm? (\textbf{calme}.) Noisy? (\textbf{bruyant}.) Last? (\textbf{dernier}.) Next? (\textbf{prochain}.) Famous? (\textbf{célèbre}.) Funny? (\textbf{drôle}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Describing words, time, numbers and verbs — a second pass}

\label{lesson:FR-R138-second-pass-describing-words-time-numbers-and-verbs}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for nice and nasty.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item nice, nasty, heat, a storm, fog
  \item grass, an ear, a lip, a number, an address
  \item a second, change, a date, a century, an email
  \item zero, sixty, seventy, ninety, a thousand
  \item to begin, to visit, to answer, to put; to put on, to believe
  \item to know, to prefer, to hope, to drive, to get dressed
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Nice? (\textbf{sympathique}.) Nasty? (\textbf{méchant}.) Heat? (\textbf{la chaleur}.) A storm? (\textbf{l'orage}.) Fog? (\textbf{le brouillard}.) Grass? (\textbf{l'herbe}.) An ear? (\textbf{l'oreille}.) A lip? (\textbf{la lèvre}.) A number? (\textbf{le numéro}.) An address? (\textbf{l'adresse}.) A second? (\textbf{la seconde}.) Change? (\textbf{la monnaie}.) A date? (\textbf{la date}.) A century? (\textbf{le siècle}.) An email? (\textbf{le courriel}.) Zero? (\textbf{zéro}.) Sixty? (\textbf{soixante}.) Seventy? (\textbf{soixante-dix}.) Ninety? (\textbf{quatre-vingt-dix}.) A thousand? (\textbf{mille}.) To begin? (\textbf{commencer}.) To visit? (\textbf{visiter}.) To answer? (\textbf{répondre}.) To put; to put on? (\textbf{mettre}.) To believe? (\textbf{croire}.) To know? (\textbf{connaître}.) To prefer? (\textbf{préférer}.) To hope? (\textbf{espérer}.) To drive? (\textbf{conduire}.) To get dressed? (\textbf{s'habiller}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
